en:
Full-stack developer with experience in both frontend and backend web development, as well as application development.
Expertise includes programming languages such as Go, JavaScript, and Dart, as well as frameworks like Vue.js,
Laravel, and Flutter. Also experienced with databases (PostgreSQL), containerization (Docker), and messaging protocols (MQTT). Previous experience as an IT apprentice with a focus on user support, troubleshooting, and hardware setup. Holds a bachelor's degree in information technology.
